name: index
description: List all custom and default CPU models.

params.name: arch
params.description: Virtual processor architecture. Defaults to the host architecture.

abstract.description: True for PVE-internal abstract profiles like x86-64-v2, -v3, -v4. These do not correspond to a QEMU CPU type and cannot be used as a custom model's 'reported-model'.

custom.description: True if this is a custom CPU model.

name.description: Name of the CPU model. Identifies it for subsequent API calls. Prefixed with 'custom-' for custom models.

vendor.description: CPU vendor visible to the guest when this model is selected. Vendor of 'reported-model' in case of custom models.

permissions.description: Custom models are filtered to those the current user has any of Mapping.{Audit,Use,Modify} on /mapping/cpu/<name>; Sys.Audit on /nodes continues to grant visibility of all custom models for back-compat.
